p: Completed in 2018, the murals depicts how the suburb of Hornsby looked like in the early 20th century, allowing visitors to take a trip back memory lane.
Serves all kinds of Vietnamese food in casual setting.Try the BBQ pork banh mi.

The go-to place for people passing through Hornsby. Attracts an older crowd than in the past. The RSL offers high tea, tapas and mixed drinks. There is a basic dress code to not wear any offensive, untidy or overly casual clothing.
